question: Who became the new CEO of NetBrain in 2026?

hits.title: NetBrain appoints three new executives to help customers chart their path to Agentic NetOps.
hits.snippet: [hires | 2026-06-30] NetBrain Technologies, Inc. hired Sean Dolan as Chief Revenue Officer on Jun 30th '26. BURLINGTON, Mass., June 30, 2026 - NetBrain Technologies, the pioneer of Agentic NetOps, today announced three executive appointments: Luvlynn Lee as Chief Customer Officer (CCO), Sean Dolan as Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), and Scott Fitzgerald as Chief Marketing Officer (CMO).
hits.summary: NetBrain Technologies, Inc. hired Sean Dolan as Chief Revenue Officer on Jun 30th '26.

hits.title: NetBrain names new CEO with Blackstone backing over the line.
hits.snippet: [hires | 2026-01-01] NetBrain Technologies, Inc. hired Bernadette Nixon as CEO on Jan 1st '26. Network operations (NetOps) solutions provider NetBrain Technologies appointed Bernadette Nixon as its new CEO, following an investment by Blackstone.
hits.summary: NetBrain Technologies, Inc. hired Bernadette Nixon as CEO on Jan 1st '26.

ar.note: Rank 2 names Bernadette Nixon as NetBrain CEO 2026.
